cards.title: &&, || and !
cards.body: `&&` (and) is true only when both sides are. `||` (or) is true when at least one side is. `!` flips true and false.

cards.title: Strictest check first
cards.body: With `else if`, the first true condition wins, so put the strictest check first or a broader one will catch it.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: `n > 5` is true, but 10 is even, so `n % 2 === 1` is false, and `&&` needs both.
